comparisons.external_protocol: ECHR Art. 13 / Art. 6 §1 (Effective Remedy & Right to a Fair Trial)
comparisons.analysis: Issuance and unverified operational use of a secondary synthetic IDNP by state administrative bodies violates the state's positive obligation to maintain legal certainty and prevents effective remedy.

comparisons.external_protocol: ECHR Protocol 7 Art. 4 (Ne bis in idem) & Art. 6 §1 / UN ICCPR Art. 14(7)
comparisons.analysis: Enforcing multiple administrative penalties for overlapping factual matrices while destroying primary case files after 1 year under retention pretext creates a procedural blackout, breaching non bis in idem guarantees.

comparisons.external_protocol: ECHR Art. 8 (Right to Respect for Private Life) & UN Principles on Continuing Consequences
comparisons.analysis: Injecting a phantom digital twin into the banking/fiscal sector while recognizing the canonical IDNP in administrative state acts constitutes arbitrary deprivation of means of subsistence (continuing consequences).
